correctness.rationale: For every n>=3 the six unordered nonedge-pair color types and capped multiplicities 0,1,>=2 evolve autonomously under the written exact local table. The standalone check_symbolic.py evaluates all 722 possible capped states representing n>=2, checks that by update six each is synchronized or is an exceptional initial periodic state, and proves the exact polynomial EGFs by symbolic integer arithmetic. The independent full-adjacency check_direct.cpp verifies 597861 labelled states for n=2..6, including sharp six-step examples and primitive period four. The trap occurs at time zero only; the exceptional 4n(n-1) labelled configurations have actual least period four, not merely a fixed multiset. The n-uniform claim follows from the exact capped reduction and finite exhaustive certificate, not numerical extrapolation.

value.rationale: The family K_{2n} minus a perfect matching is a natural highly connected graph whose local exceptional neighbor is exactly the matched partner. The theorem gives a sharp uniform six-update synchronization cutoff, an isolated asynchronous primitive-four mechanism with a polynomial 4n(n-1) state count, complete seven-layer closed forms and exponential rarity under random initial colors. These are structural infinite-family network-dynamics results beyond mere reproducibility, prior abstract periodicity, or a single small-graph census.
